training_exclusion: Exclude a target row from threshold and all three baseline labels when any blocking quality reason is present; never synthesize a replacement
duplicate_policy: Quarantine every row sharing a duplicated session; do not pick a winner
session_check: ISO date, +09:00 timezone and weekday; full JPX holiday comparison remains a separate gate
rolling_volatility: Use only complete consecutive source-row windows with no quarantined row; never bridge across an invalid row
conditional_baseline_state: Require all 61 preceding source rows valid; otherwise skip conditional state sample, not the valid target label in Base Rate
trial_freeze: Candidate is create-only; real Trial freeze requires fresh data, Terms gates, and human approval
